messages:
kevin (support): FYI getting multiple customer reports of 503s since ~09:03 UTC. Headers show 'upstream worker unavailable' and many failing requests target rwd-13b. Example request id: rq_8a3f... Request payload small, not a large seq.

maria (sre): seeing elevated restarts on a subset of hosted inference nodes in us-west-2. Kernel logs show a GPU OOM followed by container restart loop on pod inference-runner-5.

olivia (eng-runtime): confirm. Runtime reports: 
```
[2026-03-17T09:02:41Z] ERROR runner: process exited (signal SIGSEGV) pid=2345 gpu=0
[2026-03-17T09:02:41Z] INFO watchdog: evicting pod inference-runner-5
[2026-03-17T09:02:41Z] ERROR nvml: OutOfMemory on device 0
```
Seems to be OOM then segfault during ATTENTION kernel.

kevin (support): Customers hitting app timeouts and 503s. Any quick mitigation? Some customers are mid-run with time-sensitive flows.

maria (sre): immediate mitigation options: 1) drain the affected worker pool (prevent new traffic) 2) enable fallback routing to rwd-7b variant for affected routes 3) temporarily suspend batching to avoid large fused allocations. Rolling a restart loop will impact live requests.

jason (support): started routing policy change for two impacted customers -> set to fallback-model rwd-7b. I'll monitor.

deploy-bot: autoscaler: observed spike in queued requests, scaling down failed replicas due to OOM crash loop on node n-az2-17.

olivia (eng-runtime): hypothesis: a recent quantized kernel change (PR #4512) introduced an attention memory regression under certain sequence-length distributions. Reproduced locally with stress harness: sequence len ~1024 + kv prefetch.

maria (sre): can you paste the repro steps? we need to confirm before rollback.

olivia (eng-runtime): repro: 
```
# stress script
python tools/stress_infer.py --model rwd-13b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --kv-prefetch true --repeat 200
```
On our perf nodes this triggers >95% GPU memory then kernel crash in ~30s.

kevin (support): tagging affected customers and sending template update. Ticket INC-2026-789 created.

erin (product): what's expected ETA for rollback vs routing fix? Customers asking for SLA credit guidance.

olivia (eng-runtime): rollback of the quantized attention kernel (revert PR #4512) can be hotfixed to the runtime image. Build+canary deploy ~30-40m, full rollout 60-90m if canary green. Routing fallback can be immediate and is lower-risk.

maria (sre): plan: 1) continue fallback routing to rwd-7b for high-traffic customers (in progress) 2) cordon/drain affected nodes to stop crash loops 3) trigger hotfix rollback build from main@pre-4512 and deploy to one canary pool 4) if canary passes, roll to remaining hosted pools. I've started draining pod inference-runner-5 and cordoned node n-az2-17.

jason (support): notifying the two enterprise customers impacted; telling them we have a routing fallback and hotfix plan, providing estimated timeline.

kevin (support): attaching logs and sample request/response to INC-2026-789.

olivia (eng-runtime): also adding a short-term guard: reject requests with seq_len > 1024 for rwd-13b with a 429+helpful message until rollback is live. Will push policy rule.

maria (sre): after draining, crashes reduced but still seeing residual OOMs in a second pool. Might be propagation of bad image; checking container image digests across affected nodes.

deploy-bot: ci:build 4512-rollback started by olivia. artifacts: runtime-image:v2026.3.17-rc1

olivia (eng-runtime): canary deployed to pool canary-us-west-2. Running stress harness now.

maria (sre): canary looks stable for 12 minutes under 2x traffic. No OOMs. Will start progressive rollout.

jason (support): customers acknowledged the update, one asked to be pinned to dedicated capacity until SLA fully restored. I created support request SR-4421.

kevin (support): thanks team. I'll send a short incident summary to the customer list and update INC-2026-789. Please paste postmortem notes once available. :thumbsup:

olivia (eng-runtime): postmortem notes in the ticket: root cause = memory regression in quantized attention kernel introduced by PR #4512 under high seq_len + KV prefetch load. Fix = revert kernel and add CI stress test for seq_len 1024+ with kv prefetch.

maria (sre): followups: add alert for crash-rate > 3/min per pool, add auto-fallback routing policy for model hot-crashes, and increase canary traffic window.

kevin (support): last check: 503s dropped to baseline after routing + hotfix rollout. Closing active escalation but keeping incident ticket open for postmortem.

jason (support): INC-2026-789 -> status: mitigated, next: postmortem + SLA review.

maria (sre): adding runbook note about draining vs immediate rollback for memory regressions.

olivia (eng-runtime): thanks all. Will follow up with PR to add quantized-kernel test and link to the postmortem.

kevin (support): closing slack loop. If anyone sees reoccurrence ping here.
